name: Prince Panic
source:
(Translated from main site)

The main character is a 16 year old girl who grew up fast in the kingdom of Alstroemeria!
She is now being tested in order to become a maid in Alstroemeria castle!
And a week from now she will be staying in the castle for training, gradually nearing the final examination!!
 A maid☆ examination with three princes... of course her first choice is urged on by her acquainted friend Ayame who is also thinking
“Wouldn't it be good to try to become friends with the people who work in the castle?”
The princes, the castle workers are all really unique with lots of personality!!
Can she peacefully become friends with the princes!?
And become lovely-dovey with the person she has in mind!?

[From [url=http://twinproject.weebly.com/prince-panic.html]Twin Project website[/url]]
translation:
（譯自官方網站）

女主角是一名16歲的少女，在六出花王國迅速成長！
如今，她正在參加成為六出花城女僕的考核！
一週後，她將進入城堡接受訓練，並逐漸迎來最終考試！！
一場與三位王子有關的女僕☆考核……當然，她熟識的朋友菖蒲催促她先作出選擇，同時還在想著：
「試著和在城堡工作的人交朋友，不也挺好嗎？」
無論王子還是在城堡工作的人，每個人都個性十足！！
她能夠順利與王子們成為朋友嗎！？
又能與心儀的人甜蜜相戀嗎！？

[摘自[url=http://twinproject.weebly.com/prince-panic.html]Twin Project網站[/url]]
